nodes.text: By age 24 months, 52% of children had detected hMPV antibodies.   In children 2 to 5 years seropositivity reaching 80%.   By age 10 years and older, 100% of patients were seropositive.   Reinfection of hMPV is common throughout life with equal rates as initial infection.
